tasks.label: Start full development environment
tasks.command: sg docker -c "echo 'Starting...' && docker compose up -d --wait && echo 'Environment is READY. Backend: http://localhost:8000 | Frontend: http://localhost:3001'"
tasks.detail: Starts MongoDB, backend, and frontend via Docker Compose; waits for services to be ready. Requires user in docker group (sudo usermod -aG docker $USER).

tasks.label: Stop full development environment
tasks.command: sg docker -c "echo 'Stopping...' && docker compose down && echo 'Environment stopped.'"
tasks.detail: Stops all services (MongoDB, backend, frontend) via Docker Compose.
